name: Parking garage search
pitch: Find parking garages with height clearance for a high-roof van.
instructions: Search for parking garages that can accommodate a high-roof van. Look for listings that mention height restrictions, clearance heights, or vehicle size limits. Check multiple results to compare clearance measurements. When a result looks promising, open it and scan the page for the exact height clearance figure. If the height is not stated, note that the clearance is unknown. After checking several options, list the garages found with their stated clearance heights, or say that no suitable garages were found with clear height information.
starters: find parking garage for high-roof van
where can i park my high-top van

examples.ask: looking for parking with height limit for high roof van
examples.does: search for garages with height restrictions and open a few results to check clearance

skills.name: search-and-check-clearance
skills.description: Find parking garages suitable for a high-roof van.
skills.body: Start by typing the search query into web_search: "parking garage height clearance high roof van". When results appear, pick the first few and use browser_navigate to open each one. Read the page with browser_snapshot and look for numbers followed by metres, feet, or the word "clearance". If a height is found, write it down. If the page does not state a height, say so for that garage and move to the next result. Continue until three garages have been checked or no more results are left. At the end, list each garage with its stated height, or say that none of the checked pages gave a clear height measurement.

readme: Parking garage search finds parking spots that fit a high-roof van. It searches the web for garages and checks their height clearance. It will not book a spot, pay a fee, or give driving directions. It only reports what height is listed on the page.
